steps.title: Apply and send materials
steps.detail: Submit the online undergraduate application and the materials for your student type. A high school GPA of 2.75+ is required; most applicants don't need test scores.

steps.title: Visit campus
steps.detail: A personal visit or Discover Day adds $1,000 to your first-year scholarship package.

steps.title: File the FAFSA
steps.detail: Belhaven's FAFSA school code is 002397. Some aid is first-come, first-served.

steps.title: Check your scholarships
steps.detail: Merit awards are based on GPA and ACT; Early Acceptance ($1,500) requires applying by December 1.

steps.title: Pay the enrollment deposit
steps.detail: New students must pay the enrollment deposit before they can open the housing application.

steps.title: Apply for housing and pick a room
steps.detail: The housing application is in BlazeNet (opens March 1). Pay the $150 housing deposit, then select your room in your assigned window.

steps.title: Set up email, BlazeNet and Duo
steps.detail: Sign in with your Belhaven email, enroll in Duo two-factor, and reset passwords with PortalGuard.

steps.title: Meet Student Care
steps.detail: Get academic advising, tutoring through the Think Center, and request disability accommodations if needed.

steps.title: Check the academic calendar
steps.detail: Find term dates and the exam schedule.

steps.title: Apply as a transfer
steps.detail: Use the undergraduate application and choose the transfer path.

steps.title: Send official transcripts
steps.detail: Have each college send official transcripts directly to Belhaven.

steps.title: Check transfer scholarships
steps.detail: Transfer Scholarship ($15,000-$16,500) needs 12+ credits and a 2.5 GPA; Phi Theta Kappa members get $19,000.

steps.title: File the FAFSA
steps.detail: FAFSA school code 002397.

steps.title: Housing (if under 54 credits)
steps.detail: Single students under 21 with fewer than 54 credits must live on campus unless exempt.

steps.title: Set up email, BlazeNet and Duo
steps.detail: Enroll in Duo and reset passwords with PortalGuard.

steps.title: Apply with supporting documents
steps.detail: Resume, English score, passport, visa copy, evaluated transcripts, signed Affidavit of Support and proof of funds of at least $27,275.

steps.title: Get your transcripts evaluated
steps.detail: International degrees are evaluated through IEE ($120 discounted rate, usually a few days).

steps.title: Transfer your SEVIS record
steps.detail: Belhaven must have your SEVIS record transferred and activated before it can process CPT.

steps.title: Watch for your credentials email
steps.detail: After the Registrar registers you, gradinternational@belhaven.edu emails your student email, BlazeNet and Canvas logins.

steps.title: Complete orientation
steps.detail: Attend the in-person residency orientation and finish the online Canvas orientation before the term starts.

steps.title: Request CPT
steps.detail: Download the CPT packet, complete the request form and attach it to a DSO ticket. Don't start work until you have a CPT-authorized I-20.

steps.title: Apply for a Social Security number
steps.detail: Apply within 30 days of your job start with your CPT I-20, I-94, employment letter and DSO letter.

steps.title: Buy health insurance
steps.detail: Hybrid students and dependents must buy their own coverage.

steps.title: Plan your residencies
steps.detail: One weekend residency per term is mandatory to keep F-1 status; a makeup residency costs $300.

steps.title: Keep 6 credit hours every term
steps.detail: Falling below 6 credits can make your SEVIS record inactive.

steps.title: Apply online
steps.detail: Create an account and start your application; review How to Apply.

steps.title: Check costs and discounts
steps.detail: Use the tuition estimator; military, first-responder (20%), educator, nurse and alumni discounts may apply.

steps.title: File the FAFSA
steps.detail: Federal grants and loans may be available. School code 002397.

steps.title: Check computer requirements
steps.detail: Make sure your computer meets the requirements before your first 7-week term.

steps.title: Follow the accepted-student checklist
steps.detail: Complete the After You're Accepted steps.

steps.title: Set up email, BlazeNet, Canvas and Duo
steps.detail: All classes run in Canvas; enroll in Duo two-factor.

steps.title: Meet your Student Services Representative
steps.detail: They help with schedules, aid, payments and Canvas: onlinestudentservices@belhaven.edu.

steps.title: Use the library and career services
steps.detail: Digital library databases and Career & Calling are open to online students.

steps.title: Choose your program
steps.detail: Explore online master's and doctoral programs; doctoral and a few master's programs include residencies.

steps.title: Apply
steps.detail: Start your application and follow the How to Apply guidance.

steps.title: Review cost and aid
steps.detail: Check discounts and federal loans.

steps.title: Check computer requirements
steps.detail: Required before your first term.

steps.title: Set up email, BlazeNet, Canvas and Duo
steps.detail: Enroll in Duo; reset passwords with PortalGuard.

steps.title: Find research help
steps.detail: Use Hood Library databases and Ask a Librarian.
